blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In LLM-based speech translation, transcription-based chain-of-thought (CoT) suffers from a mismatch between reference transcripts used in supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and model-generated transcripts at inference. To address this, we propose joint recognition and translation fine-tuning via group relative policy optimization (GRPO). We score both transcripts and translations, with translation conditioned on model-generated transcripts, and compare three token advantage strategies. Using Qwen2.5-Omni-3B across four languages, we evaluate CoT against direct speech translation (Direct ST) under SFT and GRPO, training on CoVoST 2 and testing on CoVoST 2 and FLEURS. CoT GRPO outperforms Direct ST GRPO by 1.77 and 0.83 average BLEU points on CoVoST 2 and FLEURS. Compared to CoT SFT, GRPO boosts BLEU by 0.82 and 0.67 points and reduces word error rate (WER) by 8.8% and 7.2% relatively. These results highlight reinforcement fine-tuning as an effective method to mitigate the training-inference mismatch, jointly improving recognition and translation.
blocks.zh: 在基于LLM的语音翻译中,基于文字记录的思维链(COT)在有监督的微调(SFT)中使用的参考记录和模型生成的笔录在推论上存在不匹配. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议通过集团相对政策优化(GPRO)进行联合确认和翻译微调。 我们的成绩既包括笔录,也包括翻译,其翻译条件以模型生成的笔录为条件,并比较三种象征性优势策略. 我们使用四种语言的Quen2.5-Omni-3B,在SFT和GRPO下对照直接语音翻译(Direct ST)来评价COT,CoVoST 2的培训和CoVoST 2和FLEURS的测试. COT GPRO 业绩优于 在CoVoST 2和FLEURs上,直接ST GRPO以1.77和0.83的平均BLEU点数. 与COT SFT相比,GRPO将BLEU提升0.82和0.67分,并将单词错误率(WER)相对降低8.8%和7.2%. 这些成果突出表明,加强微调是减轻培训与推论不匹配的有效方法,可共同提高识别和翻译。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Speech translation (ST) converts source-language speech into target-language text. Cascaded systems combine automatic speech recognition (ASR) and machine translation, with early work using word lattices to pass multiple recognition hypotheses to translation [ 21 ] . Early end-to-end models translate speech without generating intermediate transcripts at inference [ 2 , 27 ] . We call this output protocol direct speech translation (Direct ST). ASR remains useful through transcription supervision and coupled decoders [ 27 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 语音翻译(ST)将源语言语音转换为目标语言文本. cascaded systems结合了自动语音识别(ASR)和机器翻译,早期的工作使用单词lattices将多个识别假说传递给翻译[21]. 早期的端到端模型在推论中翻译语音而不生成中间笔录[2,27]. 我们称这个输出协议直接语音翻译(Direct ST). ASR通过转录监督和组合解码器仍然有用 [27, 1].

blocks.en: Some large language model (LLM)-based ST systems generate a transcript followed by a translation in one response [ 10 , 12 ] . We call this protocol transcription-based chain-of-thought speech translation (CoT ST). Related work explores auxiliary ASR supervision [ 3 ] , curriculum learning [ 5 ] , and phoneme-augmented CoT [ 7 ] . ASR hypotheses also guide translation through two-pass prompting [ 9 ] or frozen-LLM representations supplied to a speech-conditioned decoder [ 8 ] . Direct ST scales more consistently with pseudo-labeled data, while CoT achieves higher peak performance [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 一些基于LLM(英语:LLM)的大型语言模型ST系统生成一个记录誊本,然后在一个响应中生成一个翻译[10,12]. 我们称之为基于协议的语录链式语音翻译(COT ST). 相关工作探索辅助性ASR监督[3],课程学习[5],电话强化CoT[7]. ASR假说也通过双路提示[9]或向语音条件解码器提供的冷冻-LLM表示来指导翻译[8]. 直接ST比例尺与伪标签数据更加一致,而CoT则实现了更高的峰值性能[14].

blocks.en:
For CoT ST, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reference transcript prefixes creates a training–inference mismatch, as translation follows potentially erroneous model-generated transcripts at inference.
Speech-awareness studies demonstrate that CoT models exhibit a strong reliance on transcripts despite access to the audio signal [ 20 ] .
To address the prefix mismatch, prior work uses predicted [ 9 ] or corrupted transcripts [ 20 ] for supervised translation training.
blocks.zh:
对于COT ST, 带参考记录稿前缀的有监督的微调(SFT)造成培训-推论不匹配,因为翻译在推论时遵循可能错误的模型生成的记录稿。
语音感知研究显示,COT模型显示,尽管可以访问音频信号,但仍强烈依赖记录誊本[20].
为了解决前缀不匹配的问题,先前的工作使用预言[9]或腐败的笔录[20]进行监督翻译培训.

blocks.en:
Discriminative training can optimize task-level criteria over model-generated hypotheses. ASR systems have long used sequence-discriminative training after cross-entropy training [ 24 ] . Minimum word error rate (MWER) training more directly targets recognition errors by minimizing expected word errors over model hypotheses [ 17 , 26 ] . Reinforcement learning (RL) similarly fine-tunes LLMs using rewards assigned to generated outputs.
In speech tasks, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) [ 22 ] has been applied to direct translation with BLEU rewards [ 6 ] and to recognition with WER, edit-distance, and exact-match rewards [ 23 ] . [ 19 ] applies GRPO to contextual ASR using rewards that prioritize biasing words.
blocks.zh:
差别化培训可以比模型产生的假设优化任务级别标准. ASR系统在交叉性训练后长期使用序列区分训练[24]. 最小字错误率(MWER)训练更直接地针对识别错误,比模型假说减少预期字错误[17,26]. 强化学习(RL)同样对LLMS进行微调,使用分配给生成产出的奖励.
在演讲任务中,团体相对政策优化(GRPO)[22]被应用到直接翻译与BLEU奖励[6],并应用WER,编辑-距离,以及精确匹配的奖励[23]. [19]将GRPO应用到背景ASR,使用优先排序偏差词的奖励.

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate GRPO for CoT speech translation, optimizing translation conditioned on model-generated transcripts. Our main contributions are: • We propose joint ASR–ST reward optimization to improve both recognition and translation within a single response generated by an audio large language model. • We score both recognition and translation outputs during rollouts and investigate the Fully Coupled, Asymmetric, and Decoupled strategies for assigning token advantages to transcript and translation segments. • Using Qwen2.5-Omni-3B and the same CoVoST 2 training examples, we empirically compare Direct and CoT ST under SFT and GRPO across four target languages. Evaluation on CoVoST 2 and FLEURS shows that CoT GRPO achieves the highest average BLEU and chrF++ among the compared systems and lowers WER relative to CoT SFT on both test sets.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查了COT语音翻译的GRPO,优化了以模型生成的语录为条件的翻译. • 我们的主要贡献是: 我们提议对ASR-ST联合奖励进行优化,以便在音频大语言模型生成的单一答复中提高识别和翻译。 在推出过程中,我们获得表彰和翻译产出,并调查Fully Conformd、不对称和脱钩战略,为记录和翻译部分分配象征性优势。 · 使用Quen2.5-Omni-3B和同样的CoVoST 2培训实例,在SFT和GPRO下对直接和COT ST进行经验性比较,使用四种目标语言。 对CoVoST 2和FLEURS的评价显示,CoT GRPO在比较系统中实现了最高的平均BLEU和chrF++,并在两个测试组上相对CoT SFT降低了WER.

blocks.zh: 我们提议联合优化ASR-ST奖励,以便在一个音频大语言模型生成的单一回复中提高识别和翻译。

blocks.en: We score both recognition and translation outputs during rollouts and investigate the Fully Coupled, Asymmetric, and Decoupled strategies for assigning token advantages to transcript and translation segments.

blocks.en: Using Qwen2.5-Omni-3B and the same CoVoST 2 training examples, we empirically compare Direct and CoT ST under SFT and GRPO across four target languages. Evaluation on CoVoST 2 and FLEURS shows that CoT GRPO achieves the highest average BLEU and chrF++ among the compared systems and lowers WER relative to CoT SFT on both test sets.
blocks.zh: 使用Quen2.5-Omni-3B和相同的CoVoST 2训练实例,我们实证地比较了SFT和GRPO下的Direct和COT ST,跨越四种目标语言. 对CoVoST 2和FLEURS的评价显示,CoT GRPO在比较系统中实现了最高的平均BLEU和chrF++,并在两个测试组上相对CoT SFT降低了WER.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The input x x consists of a task prompt and an English speech utterance. We compare two protocols for RL fine-tuning: Direct ST (Sec 3.1 ) outputs only the translation, whereas CoT ST (Sec 3.2 ) outputs the English transcript followed by the translation.
blocks.zh: 输入 xx 包含一个任务提示和一个英语语音. 我们比较了RL微调的两个协议:直接ST(Sec 3.1)只输出翻译,而CoT ST(Sec 3.2)则输出翻译之后的英文记录。

blocks.en: Decoupled : Transcript tokens receive A ^ i ASR \hat{A}_{i}^{\mathrm{ASR}} , and translation tokens receive A ^ i ST \hat{A}_{i}^{\mathrm{ST}} .
blocks.zh: Decoupled:转写符号接收A^i ASR\hat{A}_{i}^{\ mathrm{ASR},翻译符号接收A^i ST\hat{A}_{i}^{\ mathrm{ST}。

blocks.en: 3.3 Reference-Aware Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 参考-知识培训

blocks.en: We evaluate reference-aware training for both protocols, following prior extensions of GRPO that incorporate reference responses [ 6 , 19 ] . We append one reference response to each group of G G policy responses, using y ∗ y^{*} for Direct ST and the tagged ( t ∗ , y ∗ ) (t^{*},y^{*}) response for CoT ST. All G + 1 G+1 responses participate in reward normalization and the clipped objective.
blocks.zh: 我们评价在事先延长《全球资源规划》之后对这两项议定书的参考认识培训,其中纳入了参考答复[6、19]。 我们在每个G类政策答复中附上一个参考答复,使用 y * y y 表示直接ST,并用 y 表示COT ST 的标记(t , y )表示答复。 所有G+1G+1的回应都参与奖励正常化和被剪切的目标.

blocks.en: Table 1: Validation-set ablations with Fully Coupled advantages. In the Reference-aware block, 4 and 5 denote policy responses only, and 4 + 1 ref. includes one ground-truth response. Bold and underlined values indicate the best and second-best scores within each CoT block.
blocks.zh: 表1:具有 " 完全结合 " 优势的验证定值。 在 " 参考认识 " 栏目中,4和5仅表示政策反应,4+1参考文献包含一个地面真实反应。 粗体和下划线值表示每个COT区块内的最佳和次佳分数.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Data and Model
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据和模型

blocks.en: All four fine-tuned configurations (SFT and GRPO for Direct and CoT translation) are initialized from the same base model: Qwen2.5-Omni-3B [ 28 ] . Training is performed on CoVoST 2 [ 25 ] . We assign each English recording to one of four target languages (Arabic, Chinese, German, and Japanese), avoiding repeated source recordings across target languages during training. The balanced training set contains 289,412 examples, totaling 430.12 hours of English speech, with 72,353 examples per target language.
blocks.zh: 所有四个微调配置(SFT和GPRO用于Direct和COT翻译)都从同一基模型中初始化: Quen2.5-Omni-3B [28] (中文(中国大陆) ). 在CoVoST 2[25]上进行培训。 我们为四种目标语言(阿拉伯文、中文、德文和日文)中的一种安排了每一种英语录音,避免在培训期间重复使用不同目标语言的原始录音。 均衡的整套培训包括289 412个实例,共计430.12小时的英语语言,每个目标语言有72 353个实例。

blocks.en: We evaluate on all four target languages in the official CoVoST 2 validation and test sets, with 15,531 and 15,530 English recordings per target language (26.13 and 24.67 hours), respectively. For cross-corpus evaluation, we use FLEURS [ 4 ] , whose sentence IDs link parallel texts across languages. Within each split, we pair English recordings with target-language transcripts sharing the same sentence ID. This yields 1,509 validation and 2,403 test pairs from 394 and 647 unique English recordings (1.05 and 1.77 hours), respectively. FLEURS is not used for training.
blocks.zh: 我们评价CoVoST 2正式验证和测试集中所有四种目标语言,每种目标语言分别有15 531和15 530个英语录音(26.13小时和24.67小时)。 对于跨公司的评价,我们使用FLEURS [4],其句号ID将各种语言的并行文本联系起来. 每分一次,我们把英语录音与目标语言的笔录进行配对,共享同一个句子ID. 这分别从394个和647个独有的英语录音(1.05小时和1.77小时)中产生1,509个验证和2,403个测试对. FLEURS不用于培训.

blocks.en: 4.2 Training Configuration
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训配置

blocks.en: We perform full-parameter tuning with the ms-swift framework [ 30 ] on eight NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPUs using AdamW [ 11 ] . SFT uses a global batch size of 128, an initial learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , cosine decay, and 5% warmup. GRPO uses a constant learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and DAPO clipping parameters ϵ low = 0.2 \epsilon_{\mathrm{low}}=0.2 and ϵ high = 0.28 \epsilon_{\mathrm{high}}=0.28 . Unless otherwise stated, we use G = 4 G=4 without a reference. Each rollout samples responses for 32 prompts (128 policy responses; 160 for the G = 5 G=5 ablation), at temperature 1.0 and top- p p 1.0. We perform one optimizer update using all sampled responses and any added references before collecting the next rollout. We train all models for one pass over the training set.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 AdamW [11] 在 8 个 NVIDIA RTX PR 6000 GPU 上进行全参数调制, 使用 ms-swift 框架 [30] 。 SFT使用全球批量大小128,初始学习率10−5 10×5},余弦衰减,热量5%. GRPO使用10–6 10^{-6}的恒定学习率,DAPO剪辑参数 ε 低 = 0.2\epsilon _{\ mathrm{low}}=0.2 和 ε 高 = 0.28\epsilon _{\ mathrm{ high}}=0.28 . 除非另有说明,否则使用G=4 G=4而不参考. 每一次推出样本,对32个提示(128个政策响应;160个G=5个G=5个激发)的反应,温度为1.0,最高为1.0页。 在收集下一次推出之前,我们利用所有抽样答复和任何补充参考,进行一个优化更新。 我们训练所有模式 一次通过训练

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价

blocks.en: We use greedy decoding with temperature 0. Ablations and the separate comparison of advantage assignment settings use the CoVoST 2 and FLEURS validation sets.
blocks.zh: 我们用贪婪的温度解码 0,对优势分配设置的校验和单独比较使用CoVoST 2和FLEURS验证集.

blocks.en: Translation is evaluated under each system’s native prompt using SacreBLEU [ 16 ] corpus BLEU and chrF++, reported per target language and as an unweighted mean. English WER is computed after Whisper English text normalization. For the base model and Direct ST systems, we run a separate ASR-only inference pass using the prompts below to obtain transcripts for WER evaluation.
blocks.zh: 翻译在每一系统的本土提示下使用SacreBLEU[16] acident BLEU和chrF++,按目标语言报告,作为未加权平均值。 English WER是在Whisper英语文本正常化后计算的. 对于基础模型和Direct ST系统,我们使用下面的提示来运行一个单独的 ASR 唯一推论通道,以获取WER评价的笔录.

blocks.en: System: You are a speech recognition model. User: Transcribe the English audio into text without any punctuation marks.
blocks.zh: 系统:你是一个语音识别模型。 用户:将英文音频转换成文本,不带任何标点符号.

blocks.en: We also evaluate a base-model cascade without additional fine-tuning. It first transcribes the speech and then translates the resulting transcript with a text-only prompt using the same base model. Unlike CoT ST, its translation pass does not receive the speech input.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估一个基础模型级联,不作额外的微调。 它首先对语音进行转录,然后用同一基模型的仅文本的提示来翻译所产生的记录片. 与COT ST不同,其译名通行证不接受语音输入.

blocks.en: Table 2: Comparison of advantage assignment settings for CoT ST on the CoVoST 2 and FLEURS validation sets under a shared training configuration. The Fully Coupled results are repeated from the ASR-weight ablation at λ = 0.75 \lambda=0.75 . Bold values mark the best score for each metric within each dataset, including ties.
blocks.zh: 表2:共享培训配置下CoVoST 2和FLEURS验证组上CoT ST的优势分配设置比较. Fully配对结果从ASR-重量减速X=0.75\lambda=0.75重复. 粗体值表示每个数据集内每个度量的最佳分数,包括链接。

blocks.en: Table 3: Test-set results on CoVoST 2 and FLEURS. Translation scores are reported for Arabic (ar), Chinese (zh), German (de), and Japanese (ja), and their unweighted average (Avg.). WER measures English transcription. Bold and underlined values indicate the best and second-best scores in each column within each dataset across all systems.
blocks.zh: 表3:CoVoST 2和FLEURS的测试结果。 阿拉伯文(ar),中文(zh),德文(de),日文(ja)的翻译分数及其未加权平均值(Avg. WER测量英语的抄写. 粗体和下划线的数值表示所有系统每个数据集内每一列中的最佳和次最佳分数。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.1 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 1 reports sequential validation ablations for our method. All ablation configurations improve BLEU and chrF++ over Base on both sets. All ablations use Fully Coupled advantages. Starting from λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 and G = 4 G=4 with a reference, we compare the ST reward metric, reference-aware training and group size, and ASR reward weight, retaining the selections described below.
blocks.zh: 表1报告了我们方法的顺序验证。 所有膨胀配置都改进了BLEU和chrF++在两套上比Base. 所有杂乱无章地使用 Fully 组合优势。 从QQ = 0.5\lambda = 0.5和G = 4 G = 4的参考文献开始,我们比较ST奖励的度量衡,参考-认识培训和团体规模,以及ASR奖励的权重,保留以下的选题.

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Translation-Reward Metric Ablation
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 笔译-奖励计量

blocks.en: The ST reward block of Table 1 compares BLEU and chrF++ rewards. Neither reward consistently outperforms the other across corpora. The chrF++ reward gives slightly higher translation scores on CoVoST 2, whereas BLEU gives slightly higher scores on FLEURS. We retain chrF++ given its lower observed WER on both corpora.
blocks.zh: 表1的ST奖励区块比较了BLEU和chrF++奖励. 奖赏都比不上公司 chrF++奖励在CoVoST 2上给出了略高的翻译分数,而BLEU则在FLEURS上给出略高的分数. 我们保留了chrF++,因为它在两个蝎子上观测到的WER较低.

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Reference-Aware Training Ablation
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 参考-辅助培训

blocks.en: With chrF++ reward and λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 , we retain G = 4 G=4 without a reference for subsequent ablations (Table 1 , Reference-aware). This setting has higher FLEURS BLEU and chrF++ and lower WER on both corpora than G = 5 G=5 without a reference, although its CoVoST 2 translation scores are slightly lower. Relative to G = 4 G=4 with an appended reference, it has higher CoVoST 2 chrF++ and higher FLEURS BLEU and chrF++, each by over one point, but lower CoVoST 2 BLEU and slightly higher WER on both corpora.
blocks.zh: 由于chrF++的奖励和QQ=0.5\lambda=0.5,我们保留G=4G=4,而没有提及以后的擦伤(表1,参考认识). 这个设置在FLEURS BLEU和chrF++上都比G = 5 G = 5低WER,尽管其CoVoST 2的翻译分数略低. 相对于G = 4 G = 4并附参考文献,它具有更高的CoVoST 2 chrF++和更高的FLEURS BLEU和chrF++,每分超过1分,但低于CoVoST 2 BLEU和在两个公司面上略高的WER.

blocks.en: For Direct ST, reference-aware training lowers standalone ASR WER on both corpora, while its effects on translation are mixed.
blocks.zh: 对于Direct ST来说,参考意识训练在两个corpora上下架独立ASR WER,而其对翻译的影响是混合的.

blocks.en: 5.1.3 ASR-Reward Weight Ablation
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 ASR-奖励重量

blocks.en:
Table 1 (ASR weight) reports this ablation. Adding an ASR reward substantially reduces WER, with most of the reduction already present at λ = 0.25 \lambda=0.25 .
This supports using an explicit ASR reward to improve transcription accuracy during joint ASR–ST training.
blocks.zh:
表1(ASR重量)报告了这种消耗。 增加ASR奖励会大幅降低WER,大部分的降幅已经出现在QQ=0.25\lambda=0.25.
这支持在ASR-ST联合培训期间使用明确的ASR奖励来提高抄录精度.

blocks.en: The effects of the ASR reward on translation are mixed across metrics and corpora. Within this ablation, we retain λ = 0.75 \lambda=0.75 , which gives the lowest observed WER on both corpora alongside the highest CoVoST 2 BLEU and FLEURS chrF++.
blocks.zh: ASR奖励对翻译的影响在各种度量衡和corpora之间是混合的. 在这种膨胀中,我们保留了 = 0.75\lambda= 0.75, 这使得在最高的CoVoST 2 BLEU 和 FLEURS chrF++ 上观察到的最低WER 。

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison of Advantage Assignment Settings
blocks.zh: 5.2 优势转让设置比较

blocks.en: Table 2 compares token advantage assignment strategies for CoT ST on the validation sets. All three use chrF++ ST reward and G = 4 G=4 . Fully Coupled and Asymmetric use λ = 0.75 \lambda=0.75 . These settings are taken from the Fully Coupled ablations without additional tuning.
blocks.zh: 表2比较了COT ST在验证装置上的象征性优势分配策略。 三者均使用chrF++ ST奖励和G=4G=4. 完全组合和不对称使用=0.75\lambda=0.75。 这些设置取自 Fully 组合调制组, 无需额外的调制。

blocks.en: Under the shared configuration, Fully Coupled achieves the highest BLEU on both validation sets and the highest chrF++ on FLEURS. Compared with Fully Coupled, Asymmetric improves CoVoST 2 chrF++, while Decoupled lowers CoVoST 2 WER, both at the cost of lower BLEU on both corpora.
blocks.zh: 在共享配置下,Fully Uniond在两个验证组上实现最高的BLEU,在FLEURS上实现最高的chrF++. 与Fully Uniond相比,非对称性改进了CoVoST 2 chrF++,而Decouped lowers CoVoST 2 WER,两者都以两个公司公司上较低的BLEU为代价.

blocks.en: 5.3 Main Results on Test Sets
blocks.zh: 5.3 测试设备的主要结果

blocks.en: We use the Fully Coupled setting evaluated in Section 5.2 for CoT GRPO test evaluation. The validation ablations in Section 5.1 determine the remaining configuration: chrF++ reward, λ = 0.75 \lambda=0.75 , and G = 4 G=4 without a reference.
blocks.zh: 我们使用第5.2节评价的 " 完全组合 " 设置来进行COT GRPO测试评价。 第5.1节中的验证缩写决定了剩余的配置:chrF++奖励,QQ=0.75\lambda=0.75,G=4G=4没有参考.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports the test results. CoT GRPO achieves the highest average BLEU and chrF++ on both corpora and leads all per-language translation metrics except FLEURS Arabic and Japanese BLEU, where it ranks second. Its average BLEU also exceeds Direct ST GRPO by 1.77 points on CoVoST 2 and 0.83 on FLEURS.
blocks.zh: 表3报告了测试结果。 CoT GRPO在两个corpora上都实现了最高的平均BLEU和chrF++,并且领先于除FLEURS阿拉伯语和日语BLEU之外的所有每个语言的翻译度量表,它排在第二位. 其平均BLEU在CoVoST 2和FLEURs上也分别超过直接ST GPRO1.77分和0.83分.

blocks.en:
Relative to CoT SFT, GRPO improves average BLEU by 0.82 and 0.67 on CoVoST 2 and FLEURS, respectively, while also increasing chrF++ on both corpora. Relative WER reductions are 8.8% (from 7.17% to 6.54%) on CoVoST 2 and 7.2% (from 5.68% to 5.27%) on FLEURS. In contrast, Direct ST GRPO improves average translation scores over Direct ST SFT but worsens WER. These results support joint ASR–ST optimization for improving both translation quality and recognition accuracy.
For the base model, Direct ST achieves higher average BLEU and chrF++ than the cascade on both test sets. Only Chinese favors the cascade in both metrics.
blocks.zh:
相对于CoT SFT,GRPO在CoVoST 2和FLEURS上分别改进了0.82和0.67的平均BLEU,同时在两个Corpora上也增加了chrF++. 相对的WER减少值在CoVoST 2中为8.8%(从7.17%降至6.54%),在FLEURS中为7.2%(从5.68%降至5.27%)。 相比之下,Direct ST GPRO相比Direct ST SFT改进了平均翻译分数,但恶化了WER. 这些结果支持ASR-ST联合优化,以提高翻译质量和识别准确性。
对于基础模型,Direct ST实现的平均BLEU和chrF++高于两个测试机组的级联. 只有中国人喜欢两种度量衡中的级联.

blocks.en: Table 4: Transcript intervention on test sets, averaged over four target languages. Self-generated WERs (SFT/GRPO) are 7.17%/6.54% on CoVoST 2 and 5.68%/5.27% on FLEURS.
blocks.zh: 表4:测试集的译名干预,平均为四种目标语言。 自产WER(SFT/GPRO)在CoVoST 2上为7.17%/6.54%,在FLEURS上为5.68%/5.27%.

blocks.en: 5.4 Transcript Intervention Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 译文干预分析

blocks.en: We test whether the translation advantage of CoT GRPO persists with identical reference transcripts. Using the SFT and GRPO test checkpoints, we retain the speech input and CoT prompt but provide the reference transcript span and opening translation tag as an assistant prefix, then generate the translation using greedy decoding. The self-generated condition uses the native CoT results from Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 我们检验CoT GRPO的翻译优势是否与相同的参考记录一致。 使用 SFT 和 GRPO 测试检查点, 我们保留语音输入和 CoT 即时, 但提供参考记录, 自生成条件使用表3的原生COT结果。

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that reference transcripts improve average BLEU and chrF++ on both corpora. GRPO shows slightly larger gains than SFT in both BLEU and chrF++. Thus, even after joint reward optimization, translation can still benefit from a more accurate transcript. GRPO retains a translation advantage under identical reference transcripts, suggesting it can better exploit the transcript for translation.
blocks.zh: 表4显示,参考记录单改善了两个公司的平均BLEU和chrF++。 GRPO在BLEU和ChrF++中显示的增益略大于SFT. 因此,即使在联合奖励优化后,翻译仍可受益于更准确的笔录. GRPO在相同的参考笔录下保留了翻译优势,说明可以更好地利用笔录进行翻译.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We studied GRPO for CoT speech translation with joint rewards for generated transcripts and translations. In both in-domain and cross-corpus evaluation, CoT GRPO improves average translation scores over Direct ST GRPO, while improving both average translation scores and recognition over CoT SFT. Validation ablations support an explicit ASR reward for transcription accuracy, and Fully Coupled advantages yield the highest BLEU on both corpora under the shared configuration. Future work will evaluate whether these findings extend to other model scales and language directions.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了COT语音翻译的GRPO,并联合奖励生成的文字记录和翻译。 在域内和跨公司评价中,COT GRPO比Direct ST GRPO改进平均翻译分数,同时比COT SFT改进平均翻译分数和识别. 校验分解支持对转录准确性进行明确的ASR奖励,Fully Complates的优点在共享配置下使两个公司获得最高的BLEU. 今后的工作将评估这些结果是否扩大到其他示范规模和语文方向。
